[previous] watergrid-par-apply-correct-1122 (PREPARED, NOT RUN; correctness, run only after watergrid-par-check-1122 passed; noiseCheck false, Bin state apex): [WaterGrid] Par=2 apply (docs/100 §14) checked end to end. Per world: load 1 serial (Par=0, Diff=2 writes the G dump), load 2 apply (Par=2, Diff=1 diffs the whole G against load 1: only never-initialised body slots / padding may differ, the canonical hash must be equal), both with the passability and high-cost hashes pinned to the serial m1122 values. Then BP 10 min of play in apply mode (scriptErrorsMax 0). Load-time water grid only: no Sim is changed directly, so no household exemption applies; every Sim routes on the same G as vanilla only if this queue passes.
